description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Faeburrow Elder, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Faeburrow Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {W}{B}{G}.
Repeat.
